title: Reconnect with buffered, late and duplicate reports
description: The link drops for 5 s while the controller buffers its reports. On reconnect it sends the newest report first, then the 5 buffered ones (late), then re-sends 2 reports (duplicates).
what_to_look_for: Feeder: briefly UNKNOWN (no fresh data from any node), then NORMAL.
Diagnostics page: 5 late reports stored as history, 2 duplicates ignored.
No events at all: late and duplicate data never drive the current state.

steps.note: Link restored; backlog and 2 duplicates follow the newest report
